purpose: An Android manifest marks the app debuggable in a release-shaped file.

groundTruth.rationale: android:debuggable="true" lets any local user attach a debugger and read process memory, including tokens.

limitations: Line-level lexical detection only; the rule is a review prompt, not proof of exploitability.
